about: The Duo's copy of the drawing index and its search on the Drawings tab. Counts are budgets enforced by DrawingIndexTests (refreshes against the laptop indexer's made-up fixture on a made-up Dropbox) and DrawingSearchTimingTests (a made-up 20,000-drawing index); timings are measured by DrawingSearchTimingTests in an optimised build (swift test -c release) in the VellumCore tests job and compared by perf-compare.py.

entries.note: A first refresh of the fixture (3 projects): one list_folder of Vellum/Index, the manifest, and one download per shard. No thumbnail: they come down as rows show them (ADR-0017). At Zach's scale it is 2 + one per project.

File bytes a first refresh of the fixture downloads: the 666-byte manifest and its three shards (630, 4,938 and 2,510 bytes). The listing's reply is metadata, about 1 KB from Dropbox, and not counted.
A refresh downloads no thumbnail; a row downloads its own the first time it is shown online.
A refresh with nothing changed is the listing of Vellum/Index alone: index.json's content hash there is the copy's manifest's, so not even the manifest comes down.
File bytes downloaded by a refresh with nothing changed: none, only the listing's metadata.
One drawing changed on the laptop: the listing, the new manifest and that project's shard; its bytes are exactly the manifest's and the shard's (asserted), whatever the number of projects.
A thumbnail shown twice, online, downloads once; offline, or one the copy does not name, never.
The search structure of a made-up 20,000-drawing index: every entry's words and numbers packed into flat byte arrays with Int32 offsets, and the natural order. About 125 bytes a drawing.

The copy's 20,000 entries in memory, estimated: each entry's own size plus the bytes of every string longer than Swift keeps inline. About 790 bytes a drawing; index_resident_20000_mb is the measured counterpart.

Entries looked at while typing "pump house" a key at a time into the 20,000-drawing index: the first key looks at all 20,000, and each key after it only at the last key's matches. Without narrowing it would be 200,000.
The same, typing the drawing number "E-123" (100,000 without narrowing).
The same, typing a project's name: every made-up project starts "Made-up Project", so most keys look at all 20,000 until its number; the worst case of the three (380,000 without narrowing).
A first refresh of a made-up index of 2,500 one-drawing shards, Zach's scale (#98): one list_folder of Vellum/Index, the manifest, and one download per shard, none twice.
The most shard downloads in flight at once during that refresh (DrawingIndexKeeper.shardsInFlight). One before #98.

The same refresh with every 300th shard request failing once as a timed-out or dropped request: each of the 8 is asked again once, and the refresh completes. Before #98 the first failure ended the refresh as offline.
A first refresh cut off by the connection going after 1,000 of 2,500 shards, run again: the listing, the manifest and only the 1,500 shards the Duo lacks.
